app.name: Lumen
app.tagline: A 90-second heart check with the phone in your pocket.
consent.core: Lumen is a screening tool, not a diagnosis.
placement.flashOutsideBump: Lay the pad of your finger flat across the flash and the top lens.
consent.title: What Lumen is — and isn't
consent.canPulse: Measure your pulse, with a quality check
consent.canRhythm: Check your pulse rhythm for irregular patterns
consent.canHrv: Track heart rate variability and breathing
consent.cannotReplace: Replace an ECG or a doctor
consent.cannotDetect: Detect a heart attack or measure blood pressure
consent.callWarning: Chest pain or trouble breathing? Call 911 — don't take a reading.
consent.understand: I understand Lumen is a screening tool, not a diagnosis.
profile.title: About you
profile.subtitle: Used to read your results correctly. Stored only on this phone.
profile.note: These change thresholds. A pacemaker turns off rhythm screening.
phoneCheck.title: Checking your phone
phoneCheck.subtitle: About 10 seconds. Keep the app open.
phoneCheck.nextStep: Next we'll test how well your flash reaches your finger. That sets your final Lumen rating.
placement.title: Where your finger goes
placement.tipWipe: Wipe the lens if it's smudged
practice.title: Practice reading
practice.subtitle: Slide your finger until the bar says Strong, then hold still.
howToSit.title: How to sit
howToSit.subtitle: Steady arms and warm hands give the cleanest pulse.
howToSit.warm: Hands warm (rub them if they feel cold)
rating.title: Your Lumen rating
rating.subtitle: Measured on this phone, with your finger
reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.subtitle: Readings at the same time each day are the easiest to compare. Lumen can also remind you about follow-up checks.
reminders.localOnly: Local reminders only. Nothing is sent anywhere, and your lock screen never shows health details.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.limit: At most 3 reminders a day. Your lock screen never shows health details.
